يقتطف (form VIII)

# يُقْتَطَفُ (yuqtaṭafu) /juq.ta.tˤa.fu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
# يَقْتَطِفَ (yaqtaṭifa) /jaq.ta.tˤi.fa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
